title: Who digs the holes in the mound (playtest request, traced)
question: Is this the mound-hole problem you saw in the playtest? If so, which fix: (1) the curvature dig urge only counts at the nest, (2) the dig-down turn only below ground, or (3) no cuts in the mound away from the door?
context_md: Your playtest note: *Digging in the mound is obviously a problem to solve. Trace the ants that dig those holes.* Traced per ant on steady food with your switches: about 1,100 different ants per seed cut a cell or a few (top ten 4-5% of cuts). They are idle, fed foragers loafing on the mound. The 'dig where the ground curves round you' urge reads every hollow of the porous mound as a dig face, nothing stops a cut above the ground line, and soil sliding into each cut pushes the hole up, so holes pile up. On main's defaults 85% of all digging is in the mound. Report: PR 664, Reports/mound-diggers-2026-10-08/.
